name: SAL Saudi Logistics Services Company
summary: SAL Saudi Logistics Services Company provides logistics and supply chain solutions in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates in Handling, Logistics, and SAL zones segments. It offers cargo handling services to air cargo carriers operating at the Kingdom's airports and consignees for warehouse handling and storage; and end to end logistic solutions, customs clearance, and inventory management services, as well as warehouse management solutions. The company also offers streamedlined logistics operations through high-quality warehousing and bonded and non-bonded areas. The company was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
